product.name: Spring Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet enabling users to send and receive money globally through bank transfers and cryptocurrency payments.

product.name: Spring Ether Transaction Display
product.description: A service that displays users' ether transactions in USD for real-time, accurate transaction tracking on the blockchain.

product.name: Spring Internet Banking
product.description: An online platform for sending money to cryptocurrency wallets, including stable coin and ether accounts, through secure transfers.

product.name: Spring Secure Cloud Environment
product.description: A cloud-based environment that protects user information and secures payment and fund receipt processes.

product.name: Spring Transparent Account Balances
product.description: A service that displays account balances accurately on the blockchain with no hidden activities or discrepancies.

product.name: Spring Transaction Management Features
product.description: Features allowing users to upload documents, reset transaction pins, and monitor transaction statuses efficiently.
